target_customer: Solar owners, installers and financiers in the US who must register and sell renewable energy certificates
problem: Registering solar systems and selling RECs is manual and error prone across state and registry forms.
business_model: Service fee or commission on REC registration and sales, later a REC marketplace

founders.name: Nathalie Capati
founders.background_notes: YC page lists as Founder; Caplight lists as co-founder and CEO.

founders.name: Matt Mayberry
founders.background_notes: Listed as Founder on the YC page.

competitors.name: SRECTrade
competitors.what: Registered solar systems and sold SRECs for owners
competitors.traction_then: Passed 1 GW under management in Aug 2022

technical_complexity.rationale: AI reading unstructured documents to fill registry webforms across states needs brittle integrations but used existing LLM tooling.

defensibility.rationale: Registry form automation is copyable; some data and relationships with installers could create stickiness.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: SRECTrade, later part of Xpansiv, continued offering end-to-end registration; no acquisition of Jasmine found.

market_need_then: State REC programs required manual registration; SRECTrade existed to serve this pain. No spend data found.

identity.logo: Plain letter J mark per a directory; not verified.

brand_strength.rationale: No brand coverage found; common first name makes search noisy.

pivots.from: AI REC registration for solar owners
pivots.to: REC trading app and marketplace for climate assets
pivots.why: Axios headline refers to a trading app; reason not read

outcome_analysis: The cause of the inactive status is not public: no shutdown post, post-mortem or press report was found. Jasmine began as AI automation for REC registration and moved toward a trading marketplace by mid 2023 while raising small rounds, then is listed as inactive by YC. Funding amounts are mostly undisclosed, so the data cannot place it relative to the next round.
notes: No website is listed in the directory. The Axios page returned 403, so the 2023 round and the report of a $22 million valuation per the CEO come from search snippets only (a Caplight page), and the pre- or post-money status is unknown. Dates and the 2024 Alumni Ventures round rest on one aggregator (Bounce Watch). CB Insights says $2M raised over 4 rounds, unverified. A Caplight headline about a $16M Series A is a different company. Exit type unknown.
